# Wickmoor Provisions - recipe notes

The proofreading pass walks the recipe notes and reports words that were typed twice in a row.
The fragments the editors use are carded in reference/pattern-notes.tsv.

turns.prompt: Wickmoor Provisions proofreads its recipe notes and flags any word that was typed twice in a row. Give the regular-expression fragment that matches a word, the whitespace that follows it and then that same word again. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
